actions.ask_claude.description: Send a question or instruction to Claude and get a text reply.
actions.ask_claude.props.image.descripti: An image for Claude to look at along with your question.
actions.ask_claude.props.maxTokens.descr: Longest reply in tokens, about 4 characters each. Empty: 1,000.
actions.ask_claude.props.model.descripti: The Claude model to use. Newest models are listed first.
actions.ask_claude.props.prompt.descript: What you want Claude to answer or do.
actions.ask_claude.props.roles.descripti: Extra messages sent after the question, as user or assistant turns.
actions.ask_claude.props.systemPrompt.de: Standing instructions, such as a role or tone, for Claude to follow.
actions.ask_claude.props.temperature.des: From 0 to 1, lower is more focused. Newer models ignore it.
actions.ask_claude.props.thinkingMode.de: Lets Claude reason first. Uses Claude Sonnet 5.5, regardless of Model.
actions.cancel_message_batch.description: Cancels an in-progress message batch. Already-completed requests in the batch are not undone.
actions.count_tokens.description: Counts how many input tokens a prompt would use for a given model, without generating a response.
actions.count_tokens.props.model.descrip: The Claude model to use. Newest models are listed first.
actions.create_message_batch.description: Submits a batch of Messages API requests to be processed asynchronously, at up to 24 hours turnaround.
actions.create_message_batch.props.reque: Array of { custom_id, params } objects. Each custom_id must be unique within the batch; each params object matches the Messages API request body (model, messages, max_tokens, system, etc).
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Add anthropic-version: 2023-06-01. Your API key is added for you.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_message_batch.description: Deletes a message batch and its results. The batch must have finished processing first.
actions.extract-structured-data.descript: Pull the fields you define out of text, an image or a PDF.
actions.extract-structured-data.props.im: An image or PDF to pull the fields from.
actions.extract-structured-data.props.ma: Longest reply in tokens, about 4 characters each. Empty: 2,000.
actions.extract-structured-data.props.mo: The Claude model to use. Newest models are listed first.
actions.extract-structured-data.props.pr: Tells Claude what to extract. The default suits most cases.
actions.extract-structured-data.props.so: Fill in Text, Image or PDF, or both.
actions.extract-structured-data.props.te: Text to pull the fields from.
actions.get_message_batch.description: Reads the status and request counts of a message batch, to poll for completion.
actions.get_message_batch_results.descri: Reads the per-request results of a finished message batch.
Maximum number of results to return (default 100).
actions.get_model.description: Reads details for a single Claude model, or resolves a model alias to its ID.
actions.get_model.props.modelId.descript: The model ID or alias to look up.
actions.list_message_batches.description: Lists message batches, most recently created first.
actions.list_message_batches.props.after: Return the page of batches immediately after this batch ID.
actions.list_message_batches.props.befor: Return the page of batches immediately before this batch ID.
actions.list_message_batches.props.limit: Number of batches to return per page (default 20, max 1000).
actions.list_models.description: Lists the Claude models available to this API key.
auth.description:
Follow these instructions to get your Claude API Key:

1. Visit the following website: https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys.
2. Once on the website, locate and click on the option to obtain your Claude API Key.
